# Princess Cruises

> > Princess Cruises offers cruise vacations worldwide with destinations across the Caribbean, Mediterranean, Alaska, Japan, and beyond, featuring onboard experiences, shore excursions, and special occasion celebrations.

Princess Cruises provides comprehensive cruise travel services including destination guides for popular ports like Nassau, Rome, Tokyo, and Anchorage, along with onboard amenities, family programs, wellness activities, and gift card services for travelers planning cruise vacations.

- Shore Excursions

- Family & Kids Programs

- MedallionClass Technology

## Onboard Experience & Services

- [Wedding Cruises, Birthday Cruises, & Other Special Occasion Cruises](https://www.princess.com/ships-and-experience/celebrations/special-occasions): Special occasion cruises: weddings, birthdays, anniversaries & vow renewals
- [Kids, Teens & Families](https://www.princess.com/ships-and-experience/onboard-experience/kids-and-teens): Family cruise programs with kids/teens activities & MedallionClass tech
- [Cruise Gifts - Cruise Gift Cards, Ideas & Services](https://www.princess.com/ships-and-experience/celebrations/cruise-gifts-services): Cruise gift cards & packages: beverage bundles, Princess Cellars & romance
- [Get in Shape with Princess Cruises](https://www.princess.com/blog/get-in-shape-with-princess-cruises): Cruise fitness & wellness tips featuring Lotus Spa onboard programs
- [Frequently Asked Questions - Gift Cards](https://www.princess.com/ships-and-experience/celebrations/gift-cards/faq): Gift card FAQ for US/Canada residents with purchase & redemption details

## Caribbean Destinations

- [Top 7 Nassau Beaches](https://www.princess.com/blog/nassau-beaches): Guide to Nassau's best beaches including Paradise Island & Love Beach

## Mediterranean & European Ports

- [Cruise to Italy's Amalfi Coast](https://www.princess.com/blog/cruise-to-italys-amalfi-coast): Amalfi Coast Mediterranean cruise destination guide for Italy
- [A Local's Guide to Rome, Italy](https://www.princess.com/blog/a-locals-guide-to-rome): Local insider Rome guide: dining at Meglio Fresco & Il Goccetto wine bar
- [5 Turkish Cuisine Dishes You Must Try During Your Next Mediterranean Cruise](https://www.princess.com/blog/turkish-cuisine): Turkish cuisine guide for Mediterranean cruise travelers to Istanbul
- [Best Cities in Norway Other Than Oslo](https://www.princess.com/blog/the-best-cities-to-visit-in-norway): Norway city guide: Bergen, Tromsø, Ålesund & Stavanger destinations
- [Learn the History of Berlin Through Sightseeing](https://www.princess.com/blog/learn-the-history-of-berlin-through-sightseeing): Berlin history tour from Warnemunde port: Berlin Wall & Checkpoint Charlie

## Alaska & Pacific Coast

- [Top 15 Things to Do in Anchorage, Alaska](https://www.princess.com/blog/top-15-things-to-do-in-anchorage-alaska): Anchorage attractions: Tony Knowles Trail, Portage Glacier & wildlife tours
- [23 Magical Things To Do in Astoria, Oregon](https://www.princess.com/blog/things-to-do-in-astoria-oregon): Astoria, Oregon port guide with Columbia River & Pacific Coast attractions
